question.problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $p=⟨0,1,-1⟩$, $q=⟨-2,3,1⟩$ and $r=⟨-1,4,3⟩.$
question.worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}p\cdot (q\times r) & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & -1 \\ -2 & 3 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =0-((-2)\cdot 3-(-1)\cdot 1)-((-2)\cdot 4-(-1)\cdot 3) \\  & =5+5 \\  & =10\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is

$$
V=|10|=10.
$$
